main.description:
Details of the materials and inputs delivered by a supplier to a grower as input for their crop process. An inbound
delivery describes a certain amount of a certain product acquired by a grower through an order to
a supplier.

thirdPartyIds.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the inbound delivery is identified by third parties.

dateOfDelivery.description: Date at which the product is delivered at the location of the grower ("YYYY-MM-DD")

quantity.description: Quantity of the product delivered to the grower.

location.description: Identification of the production location of the grower at which the product is delivered
